# Respawn reference

The component that runs a unit's death-to-respawn flow, the respawn points in the scene, and the rules asset that sets delay, place, health and penalties. For how to use it, see [Respawn](../modules/respawn.md).

## VtUnitRespawn

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Respawn → VtUnitRespawn**. Adds [VtUnitStats](units.md#vtunitstats) automatically.

Runs a unit's death-to-respawn flow by its `VtRespawnRules`: waits the delay, picks the place, applies the XP and durability penalties, moves the unit there and revives it. Attached by `VtUnit` when the definition has rules.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rules (`rules`) | [VtRespawnRules](#vtrespawnrules) | None | Delay, place, health and penalties. Required. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsWaiting { get; }` | True between death and respawn. |
| `float SecondsRemaining { get; }` | Seconds until `Respawn` is allowed; 0 when ready or alive. |
| `bool CanRespawnNow { get; }` | True when dead and the delay has passed. |
| `bool HasCheckpoint { get; }` | True once `SetCheckpoint` has been called. |
| `Vector3 Checkpoint { get; }` | The last checkpoint position. |
| `Vector3 DeathPosition { get; }` | Where the unit last died. |
| `event Action<float> OnDeathStarted` | Fires when the unit dies and the wait begins. Arg: seconds until respawn is allowed. |
| `event Action OnRespawnReady` | Fires once when the delay has passed on non-automatic rules. |
| `event Action<Vector3> OnRespawned` | Fires after the unit was moved and revived. Arg: where it came back. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings and subscribe to the death event. Idempotent; public for the late-attach path. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the respawn delay. Runs on the authority only. |
| `bool Respawn()` | Bring the unit back now. Refused while alive or before the delay has passed. On a predicting client the request is forwarded and this returns false. |
| `void SetCheckpoint(Vector3 position)` | Remember `position` for `VtRespawnMode.Checkpoint` rules. |
| `void ApplyRespawnStateFromNet(bool isWaiting, float seconds, Vector3 diedAt, bool checkpointSet, Vector3 checkpointPosition)` | Replace the wait and checkpoint state. Used by loading and replication; not authority-gated. |

## VtRespawnPoint

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Respawn → VtRespawnPoint**.

A place units come back to life. Drop one in the scene per graveyard, shrine or base. `VtUnitRespawn` picks the nearest point that accepts the unit's faction, or a specific one by id.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty | Stable id for Fixed Point respawn rules. Optional; convention: 'respawn.<area>'. |
| Factions (`factions`) | [VtFaction](#vtfaction)[] | Empty | Factions this point serves. Empty = every faction. |
| Gizmo Color (`gizmoColor`) | `Color` | `#4CFF8099` | Color of the editor gizmo drawn when this point is selected. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static IReadOnlyList<VtRespawnPoint> All { get; }` | Every enabled point in the scene. |
| `static VtRespawnPoint Find(string id)` | The enabled point with `id`, or null. |
| `static VtRespawnPoint Nearest(Vector3 from, VtFaction faction)` | The closest enabled point on the ground plane that accepts `faction`, or null when none does. |
| `bool Accepts(VtFaction faction)` | True when this point serves `faction`. |
| `void Register()` | Add this point to the scene registry. Idempotent; public for late-attach callers. |

## VtRespawnRules

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Respawn → Respawn Rules**.

What happens after a unit dies: how long it waits, where it comes back, with how much health, and what it loses. Assign to `VtUnitDefinition.respawnRules`; `VtUnit` attaches a `VtUnitRespawn` that runs the flow. One asset usually serves every player; monsters use spawners instead.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Delay Seconds (`delaySeconds`) | `float` | 5 | ≥ 0 | Seconds between death and the earliest respawn. Counts in simulation time. |
| Automatic (`automatic`) | `bool` | On |  | Respawn as soon as the delay is over. Uncheck to wait for VtUnitRespawn.Respawn from your UI, for a 'release' button. |
| Mode (`mode`) | [VtRespawnMode](#vtrespawnmode) | `NearestPoint` |  | Where the unit comes back. |
| Point Id (`pointId`) | `string` | Empty |  | Id of the VtRespawnPoint to use in Fixed Point mode. Falls back to the nearest point. |
| Revive Hp Fraction (`reviveHpFraction`) | `float` | 0.5 | 0 to 1 | Health on respawn as a fraction of maximum. Never below 1 HP. |
| Xp Loss Fraction (`xpLossFraction`) | `float` | 0 | 0 to 1 | Fraction of the XP earned toward the next level that is lost. Never drops a level. |
| Durability Loss Fraction (`durabilityLossFraction`) | `float` | 0 | 0 to 1 | Fraction of each equipped item's maximum durability worn off on respawn. For an item that copies were combined into (Durability Mode Uses), the fraction of one copy's durability. |

## Enums

### VtFaction

Team or allegiance of a `VtUnit`. Units of different factions fight each other unless either is Neutral; AI targeting, splash damage and projectiles all respect it.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Neutral` | Unaffiliated or ambient — not targeted, not hostile. |
| `Player` | The local player and their summons / pets. |
| `Enemy` | Scripted hostile units (waves, bosses). |
| `Wildlife` | Passive NPCs (deer, rabbits) — flee when attacked, don't aggro. |

### VtRespawnMode

Where a respawning unit reappears.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `NearestPoint` | The closest `VtRespawnPoint` that accepts the unit's faction; where it died if there is none. |
| `FixedPoint` | The `VtRespawnPoint` named by `VtRespawnRules.pointId`; the nearest point if missing. |
| `Checkpoint` | The last position passed to `VtUnitRespawn.SetCheckpoint`; the nearest point before any is set. |
| `WhereDied` | Exactly where the unit died. |
